notes.title: DEATHWATCH Sequel Announced!
notes.content:
The sequel to DEATHWATCH - DEATHWATCHERS is now available to wishlist! DEATHWATCHERS takes the spot the difference horror genre to the next level with full 4 Player Co-Op and full first person world interaction. Group up or go in solo, buy your equipment and see if you can banish the entities throughout each location!

DEATHWATCHERS sticks to it's roots, it's not just another ghost hunting game. Place cameras, take photos, setup lighting and various other pieces of equipment all while keeping a keen eye on your environment to make sure you can spot any changes. Use your new handheld Event-Logger to scan the environment for specific changes. From the classics such as 'Object Move', 'Object Disappearances' to new events such as 'Voids' that damage you over time. But don't worry there's necessary equipment for every job, just make sure you bring it with you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2599370/DEATHWATCHERS/
